value.description: If the rear lot line abuts a lot in the Residential Zone category and the garden suite building has openings such as windows in its rear main wall above 4.0 m above average grade, the (B) rear yard setback of 1.5 m is increased by 1.5 m.
value.gaps: Scope not tested (M-149): the rear lot line abutting a Residential-zone lot, and rear-wall openings above 4.0 m (a design choice, suite_wall_openings). value.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3) and (6) and 10.10.60.20(1), where the side lot line does not abut a street and the side main wall has openings such as doors or windows, the garden suite's minimum side yard setback is the greater of 1.5 m or 10 percent of the lot frontage, to a maximum of 3.0 m.
value.gaps: Scope not tested (M-149): a side lot line not abutting a street, and openings in the side main wall (a design choice, suite_wall_openings). Restrictive (a 1.5 m floor instead of (B)'s 0.6 m), so it is disclosed, never applied to the maximum (M-172(3), M-177(3)); (B) answers. 'To a maximum of 3.0 metres' read as capping the 10 percent amount.
